title: PersonaCompiler — PersonaRecord → PersonaUXProfile with promptBlock
acceptance: Profile includes background, six uxBehavior facets, the four taskBehaviorInstructions strings, and a rendered promptBlock
promptBlock always includes the docs/03 §Required persona system instruction verbatim
No invented demographics — the compiler must not assert facts not present in the input record (test: missing occupation in row → not 'I am a developer' in promptBlock)
Derived UX traits (digitalConfidence, decisionStyle, etc.) come from PersonaRecord.derivedTraits when set; fall back to safe defaults otherwise
Tests: round-trip a Korea-shaped record through normalizer → compiler → PersonaUXProfileSchema; promptBlock contains the required instruction; no representativeness claim language
